messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "consume only the daily amounts recommended by your doctor or nutrition counselor"
set: ["consume only the daily amounts recommended by your doctor or nutrition counselor", "follow the diet plan created for you by your doctor or nutrition counselor", "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor", "use only the brand and form prescribed by your doctor", "avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes", "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor", "only use as prescribed by your physician", "stay within the recommended daily limit on the packet", "take as prescribed by your doctor", "use as directed by your doctor", "do not use in larger amounts or for longer than recommended", "do not take in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended", "traveling by car or airplane while wearing the infusor is not recommended", "take exactly as directed on the label or as prescribed by your doctor", "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor", "only under your doctor's guidance"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor",
    "use only the brand and form prescribed by your doctor",
    "only use as prescribed by your physician",
    "take as prescribed by your doctor",
    "use as directed by your doctor",
    "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor",
    "take exactly as directed on the label or as prescribed by your doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "use as prescribed by your doctor"
}
